card.name: Partway through rare or foreign words
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of rare words, especially Lao script characters and split-up foreign or Latin-style words. It responds inside the word, before it is finished.

modes.label: Lao script
modes.description: Single Lao characters or byte pieces inside Lao text, such as in a national motto.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເອກ<<ະ>>ລາດ ປະຊ

modes.label: Split rare words
modes.description: Middle pieces of uncommon Latin, German or Malay words, or a lab term.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of unusual words and non-Latin script, such as Lao text, when the word is split into pieces.
